title: Unused dependency: iana-time-zone in common/Cargo.toml
description: iana-time-zone is listed as a runtime dependency but never imported in crates/common/src/. The actual user is crates/config/src/schema/core.rs.
suggested_fix: Remove iana-time-zone from common/Cargo.toml. Add it to config/Cargo.toml if not already present.

title: Unused dev-dependency: tempfile in common/Cargo.toml
description: tempfile is listed under [dev-dependencies] but never imported in any test module within common.
suggested_fix: Remove tempfile from common [dev-dependencies].

title: Dead function: format_datetime_local
description: Only called within date.rs tests. No production caller exists. Exported as pub but never used outside the file.
suggested_fix: Remove or mark as #[cfg(test)] if only needed for tests.

title: Dead function: timezone_utc_offset
description: Only tested in date.rs tests. No external callers found. (INVALID: actually used in agent/context_sources/identity.rs)
suggested_fix: Remove or mark as #[cfg(test)].

title: Dead function: format_timestamp_ms
description: Exported as pub, never referenced outside the module. crates/tools uses its own private version. Silently uses Utc::now() as fallback on invalid ms.
suggested_fix: Remove the dead function.

title: Money and Currency types are entirely dead code (297 lines)
description: common::Money and common::Currency are re-exported but zero callers exist in the workspace. feature-finance uses its own currency handling. The rust_decimal dependency is only retained for this dead module.
suggested_fix: Remove money.rs entirely, remove re-exports from lib.rs, remove rust_decimal from common/Cargo.toml.

title: Money to_minor_units silently returns 0 on overflow
description: to_i64().unwrap_or(0) for large amounts returns 0 instead of an error. Moot since Money is dead code.
suggested_fix: Will be resolved by removing dead Money module (L0-006).

title: KlyntbotError::Goal and KlyntbotError::Plan are dead error variants
description: Never constructed anywhere except in the error module's own tests. Legacy stubs for planned features.
suggested_fix: Remove Goal and Plan variants and their test usage.

title: MessageRole::parse_strict uses semantically wrong error variant
description: A parsing error about a message role uses KlyntbotError::Bus which is semantically incorrect.
suggested_fix: Use KlyntbotError::Tool(ToolError::InvalidParams(...)) or a dedicated parse error.

title: Confusing dual re-export of NotificationSender
description: NotificationSender is reachable via both common::NotificationSender and common::notify::NotificationSender, creating confusion about which path is canonical.
suggested_fix: Remove the re-export from notify.rs since lib.rs already re-exports from ports.

title: HTTP client error uses wrong error category
description: build_http_client failure wraps in ChannelError::ConnectionFailed which is semantically incorrect — it's a config/TLS error.
suggested_fix: Use a more appropriate error variant.

title: Duplicate cosine_similarity implementations
description: common/helpers.rs defines the canonical implementation, but context_engine/reasoner.rs has a private copy that differs (no NaN handling).
suggested_fix: Remove the duplicate in context_engine and import from common::helpers.

title: AppleScript injection vulnerability in get_browser_url
description: app_name is passed to osascript without sanitization. If app name contains double-quote, it can break out and execute arbitrary commands. sanitize_for_applescript exists in common::notify but is not used here.
suggested_fix: Apply sanitize_for_applescript to app_name before interpolation.

title: is_browser uses .unwrap() on already-checked Option
description: bundle_id.unwrap() is guarded by .is_some() but is anti-idiomatic. Should use map_or or if-let.
suggested_fix: Refactor to use bundle_id.map_or(false, |id| ...) pattern.

title: get_browser_url uses blocking std::process::Command
description: AppleScript can block for seconds. Uses synchronous Command::output() which blocks the calling thread/tokio executor.
suggested_fix: Use tokio::process::Command or document as blocking-only.

title: extract_icon uses blocking std::process::Command for sips
description: Synchronous shell invocations for PlistBuddy and sips block the executor during icon resolution.
suggested_fix: Use tokio::process::Command or spawn_blocking.

title: AppIconCache::new silently ignores directory creation errors
description: let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&cache_dir) discards errors. Cache misses on every call if dir can't be created.
suggested_fix: Log warning on failure via tracing::warn!.

title: get_screen_frame non-macOS stub hardcodes 1920x1080
description: Returns hardcoded 1920x1080 which is a false assumption. Should indicate unavailability.
suggested_fix: Return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) to communicate unavailability.

title: Expand-tilde edge case: ~foo mishandled
description: If user passes '~foo' (tilde without slash), starts_with('~') matches but trim_start_matches('~/') strips nothing, resulting in home.join('~foo') which is wrong.
suggested_fix: Guard with starts_with('~/') instead of starts_with('~'), or handle ~foo as literal.

title: set_provider_key silently ignores unknown provider names
description: The _ => {} arm provides no feedback when an unrecognised provider name is passed.
suggested_fix: Log a warning or return a Result indicating the unknown provider.

title: all_providers() returns fixed-size array [..; 12] that must be manually synced
description: The array size 12 is hardcoded. Adding a provider requires updating this separately.
suggested_fix: Use a Vec or const-computed array length.

title: env.rs macros capture $config but never use it
description: Both env_string! and env_secret! accept a $config:expr parameter that is never referenced. Vestigial dead macro parameter.
suggested_fix: Remove the unused $config parameter from macro signatures.

title: Default model name hardcoded as string with no constant
description: AgentDefaults.model hardcodes 'anthropic/claude-opus-4-5' and the test at loader.rs:205 duplicates this string.
suggested_fix: Extract to a named constant DEFAULT_MODEL and reference from both places.

title: take_inbound_rx / take_outbound_rx use .unwrap() on Mutex lock
description: Inconsistent with rest of codebase which uses .expect() for Mutex locks.
suggested_fix: Replace .unwrap() with .expect('message bus lock poisoned').

title: LearningEventBus::publish is async for no reason
description: broadcast::Sender::send is synchronous. The async keyword adds overhead without benefit. DomainEventBus::publish is correctly non-async.
suggested_fix: Change from async fn to fn.

title: Dead public API: search_tools has no external callers
description: search_tools is only called from the crate's own test. No other crate calls it.
suggested_fix: Mark as pub(crate) or remove if not planned for use.

title: Regex recompiled on every schema validation call
description: validation.rs calls Regex::new(pattern) on every tool invocation with a pattern constraint. Regex compilation is expensive.
suggested_fix: Cache compiled regexes (OnceLock/LazyLock per pattern or a RegexCache).

title: Dead struct fields: ToolMetadata author, version, examples, related_tools
description: author, version default to '' and are never set. examples and related_tools are always empty Vec across all tools.
suggested_fix: Remove dead fields or add #[serde(skip_serializing_if)] to reduce payload size.

title: classify_type silently falls back to 'string' for unknown types
description: If a field type is not a recognised primitive (e.g. Uuid, NaiveDate, custom newtype), the macro emits 'type': 'string' with no warning. Produces incorrect schemas.
suggested_fix: Emit a compile_error! or at minimum a #[warning] for unrecognised types.

title: Array field extraction only handles Vec<String>
description: The macro uses .as_str().map(String::from) for all array elements. Vec<i64> or Vec<bool> params silently produce empty vecs.
suggested_fix: Extract based on inner type. Use classify_type to determine array item extraction.

title: All array items hardcoded as 'string' in generated JSON schemas
description: gen_schema_property hardcodes items: {type: string} for all array fields regardless of actual inner type.
suggested_fix: Use inner type classification to set correct items type in schema.

title: optional_i64 extraction uses as_u64() for signed integer optionals
description: For Option<i8/i16/i32/i64> fields, macro uses as_u64() instead of as_i64(). Silently fails to extract any negative integer, producing None.
suggested_fix: Use as_i64() for signed integer optional extraction.

title: tool_actions macro uses panic! instead of syn::Error for error conditions
description: Proc macros should use syn::Error for well-formed compiler diagnostics with source spans. panic! produces terse errors with no location.
suggested_fix: Replace panic! with syn::Error::new(...).to_compile_error().

title: tool_actions schema merging silently drops duplicate parameter names
description: If two actions share a parameter name with different types, the first wins silently with no warning.
suggested_fix: Emit compile_error! on duplicate parameter names with different types.

title: withdrawal_simulation panics instead of propagating error
description: MonteCarloEngine::run returns Result but withdrawal_simulation uses .expect() which panics on engine failure. Function signature should return Result.
suggested_fix: Change return type to common::Result<WithdrawalResult> and use ? operator.

title: Incomplete stub: years_to_coast always returns None when not at coast
description: The calculation for how many more years until portfolio grows to coast_number is not implemented. Always returns None.
suggested_fix: Implement the calculation: solve for n in current * (1 + real_return)^n = coast_number.

title: Unused serde_json dependency in analytics
description: serde_json is listed in analytics/Cargo.toml but no serde_json import exists in any source file.
suggested_fix: Remove serde_json from analytics/Cargo.toml.

title: Duplicate Pearson correlation implementations
description: Two separate pearson_correlation impls: one on &[Decimal] in spending/correlation.rs and one on Vec<(f64,f64)> in portfolio/correlation.rs. Won't fix: implementations operate on different types (Decimal vs f64) with different signatures — unifying adds generics complexity with no practical benefit.
suggested_fix: Unify into a shared generic helper.

title: Duplicate compute_median_i64 reimplements shared median logic
description: compute_median_i64 in recurring.rs duplicates the sort-and-pick logic from spending/mod.rs. Won't fix: compute_median_i64 operates on i64 day intervals while compute_median uses Decimal. Converting adds overhead for no benefit in a tight loop.
suggested_fix: Unify with a generic median function or convert to Decimal before calling shared version.

title: TODO: Wire rmcp streamable HTTP server transport
description: Embedded MCP HTTP server initialization exits with warning. HTTP transport not yet implemented.
suggested_fix: Implement HTTP transport or document as Phase 4 feature and convert TODO to tracked issue.

title: TODO(phase-3): Replace flashcard review_success_rate with source_note_id query
description: Stub implementation returning 0.0. Old insight_review_id column was removed in FSRS-5 migration.
suggested_fix: Implement source_note_id-based query in feature-learning or remove if feature is not needed.

title: TODO: Wire rmcp streamable HTTP server (Phase 4)
description: Standalone MCP server only supports stdio. HTTP transport exits with error.
suggested_fix: Implement HTTP transport or clearly document as post-release feature.

title: TODO: Implement tool listing CLI command (Phase 2)
description: CLI tool introspection commands (list, schema) print 'not yet implemented' messages.
suggested_fix: Implement or remove the CLI subcommands if not needed for release.

title: console.log with sensitive OAuth data in production
description: McpServersSettings.tsx:120,123 logs OAuth provider name and result to browser console in production builds.
suggested_fix: Remove or guard behind import.meta.env.DEV.

title: No root ErrorBoundary — uncaught render errors show blank screen
description: App.tsx only has Suspense with fallback={null}. No ErrorBoundary at app root. Only IssueDetailErrorBoundary exists for tasks detail.
suggested_fix: Add a root ErrorBoundary component wrapping the app.

title: Unused dependency: lottie-react (0.5MB+)
description: lottie-react is in package.json but zero imports exist in src/. Ships unused in production bundle.
suggested_fix: Remove lottie-react from package.json.

title: Dead hooks: useSubtasks, useProjectSources, useProjectMemories, useProjectConversations
description: Four hooks exported from shared/hooks/ barrel but never imported by any feature component.
suggested_fix: Remove dead hooks or mark as draft if planned for future use.

title: Unhandled promise rejections in clipboard.writeText calls
description: Multiple clipboard.writeText calls without try-catch: InsightReviewPanel.tsx:161, ConceptMapTab.tsx:63, IntegrationsSettings.tsx:62.
suggested_fix: Wrap in try-catch or add .catch() handler.

title: TODO stubs: useProjectConversations, ArchivedSettings, useEditorActions Ask AI, MCP Edit button
description: Four TODO comments marking unimplemented features that show UI elements but do nothing when interacted with.
suggested_fix: Either implement or remove the non-functional UI elements.

title: Settings save errors silently swallowed to console.error
description: All settings pages (Configuration, General, Personalization) catch save errors with console.error only. No user-visible error feedback.
suggested_fix: Show toast notification on save failure.

title: Dead code: taskMemory always null, rejectDecomposition never called, no-op ternary
description: useIssueDetail.ts:325 taskMemory hardcoded null (AI insights never render), rejectDecomposition returned but unused, IssueDetailView.tsx:47 ternary produces same value both branches.
suggested_fix: Remove dead code paths and no-op conditionals.

title: Non-atomic feature migrations — crash between SQL and tracking INSERT
description: run_feature_migrations executes migration SQL and tracking INSERT as separate statements. Crash between them causes re-run on next startup.
suggested_fix: Wrap both statements in an explicit transaction.

title: INSERT OR REPLACE silently changes primary key in allocation targets
description: INSERT OR REPLACE deletes conflicting row and inserts new one with new id. FK references to old id break.
suggested_fix: Use INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET to preserve existing id.

title: Silent dependency deserialization makes blocked tasks appear unblocked
description: Malformed blocked_by JSON returns empty Vec via unwrap_or_default(). Task appears unblocked.
suggested_fix: Log warning and skip task rather than treating as unblocked.

title: count_tasks_by_status queries wrong table (actions instead of tasks)
description: Project stats count from actions table, not tasks. Projects show zero task counts.
suggested_fix: Query the tasks table.

title: sanitize_predicate_value incomplete — single quote injection in LanceDB
description: Blocks ; and -- but not single quotes. delete_where accepts raw predicate unguarded.
suggested_fix: Block single quotes. Sanitize delete_where input.

title: Session delete leaks from lru_order — unbounded memory growth
description: delete() removes from sessions HashMap but NOT from lru_order IndexMap.
suggested_fix: Also remove from lru_order in delete method.

title: Transcription MIME type hardcoded as audio/ogg for all formats
description: Always audio/ogg regardless of file extension (.mp3, .wav, .m4a, .webm).
suggested_fix: Detect MIME type from file extension.

title: Provider candidates list duplicates registry — new providers excluded from fallback
description: factory.rs candidates hardcodes provider names. New providers not in both lists are excluded.
suggested_fix: Generate candidates from PROVIDERS registry.

title: Orchestrator token estimate always 500 — causes budget under-allocation
description: estimated_tokens() returns hardcoded 500. Complex skills can be thousands of tokens.
suggested_fix: Calculate from skill body size.

title: Entire manifest parsing feature is dead code
description: parse_manifest exists but never called. parse_skill_md sets manifest: None unconditionally.
suggested_fix: Remove or wire up.

title: Intervention result discarded — entire intervention subsystem is dead code
description: InterventionRouter.evaluate() result assigned to _ and dropped. All intervention logic runs but produces no effect.
suggested_fix: Wire result to notification system or remove dead subsystem.

title: CognitiveAccessor dependency injected but never used
description: cognitive field stored with #[allow(dead_code)]. Never referenced in InsightService.
suggested_fix: Remove or implement cognitive integration.

title: is_plugin_table permission guard is dead code — no table sandboxing
description: Table-name sandboxing function exists but never called. Plugins could write to any SQLite table.
suggested_fix: Wire is_plugin_table into DB write host function.
